title: Repeat native guidance checks using focused examples

intentCoverage.report:
Verdict: Confirmed missing test path (bounded to the examined check).

Story and revision: SEED-393 section `repeat-native-guidance-checks-on-real-story-examples` (key example 5), plan 674 slice 1, revision 4d50a0a39412906f6ce8fddd659d88ba1318dae0, in an isolated detached scratch worktree that was clean before the probe.

Promise (the suggestion, kept as given): after the active names move, a maintainer can recover a kept historical record, and its original recorded bytes and input hashes stay recoverable.

Fault: in Distribution/evaluation/src/native-comparison-basis.sh, `native_comparison_basis_observe` (line 163). I removed the two historical alternatives `*"native-comparison/${name}/"*` and `*"cases/comparison/${name}/"*` and kept only `*"cases/guidance-checks/${name}/"*`. I did not touch any fixture or assertion.

Maintained check examined: Distribution/evaluation/tests/native-guidance-checks/native-comparison-refresh.sh (refresh and recovery). Its recovery assertions are `grep -Fqx "case-basis-directory: ${case_dir}"`, `recovery: pass` and `report_is`. Its fixture records are made at `case_dir=Distribution/evaluation/cases/guidance-checks/paused-supplier`, so their input paths only ever use the new path form. The test then moves `Distribution` to `Moved`, but the recorded paths still contain `cases/guidance-checks/<case>/`. So the check never runs recovery on a record whose inputs were saved under the historical `tests/native-comparison/` or `cases/comparison/` forms. I also grepped Distribution/evaluation/tests and Distribution/tests for `--recover` and `native_comparison_basis_observe`. The only other hit is a skill-text test (dough-story-refinement/preparation-assignment-continuation.test.mjs), which does not exercise recovery.

Independent witness: `Distribution/evaluation/src/native-guidance-check.sh --recover Distribution/evaluation/cases/guidance-checks/paused-supplier/comparisons/20261114T102744-1921.txt`. This is a real kept record whose 49 inputs are under `Distribution/tests/native-comparison/paused-supplier/`.

Runs, all with `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/evaluation/tests/native-guidance-checks/native-comparison-refresh.sh` from the scratch checkout. Reach was confirmed through OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_OUTCOMES and OPEN_DOUGH_TEST_TIMES.
- Baseline: exit 0, outcome `passed`, 86.8 s. The witness gave `recovery: pass`, `case-basis-directory: Distribution/tests/native-comparison/paused-supplier`, and "the recorded inputs are byte-identical at 764c4e0f…".
- Faulted: the witness exited 1 with `named-revision: none`, `case-basis-revision: none`, `case-basis-searched: no case directory recorded`, `recovery: fail` and "no commit of this repository holds the recorded inputs … the basis is not recoverable from Git". That is the promised behavior going wrong on the intended path. The same focused command still exited 0, outcome `passed`, 101.9 s.
- Restored: I restored with `git checkout --` (a trap guarded the faulted run). `git status --short` was empty and HEAD was still 4d50a0a39. The same command exited 0, outcome `passed`, 71.6 s. The witness again gave `recovery: pass` with the historical case-basis directory. I then removed the scratch worktree.

Omitted transition: recovering a kept record whose recorded input paths use a historical case-directory form (`tests/native-comparison/<case>/` or `evaluation/cases/comparison/<case>/`). The maintained check covers only records saved under the current `cases/guidance-checks/<case>/` form.

Next proof action: add journey proof that recovers a record with historical-form input paths, for example by having the refresh fixture write a record before renaming the collection. That proof should assert `recovery: pass`, the historical `case-basis-directory`, and an unchanged report.

Cost:
- Test runtime: measured by the runner's job times, in seconds per run of the one focused check. 86.8 s baseline (plus an earlier identical baseline run of 104.3 s wall that did not record its outcome), 101.9 s faulted, 71.6 s restored. Load average was about 19.
- Human effort: unavailable. No human took part in the probe, and there is no separate measure.
- Agent effort: unavailable. Token and turn counts are not visible to this agent.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 459954 ms (measured), from 1794905660413 to 1794906120367 in Unix epoch ms.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision 4d50a0a39412906f6ce8fddd659d88ba1318dae0. Decision: the gap was not a delivered defect, because the witness passes at the checked revision. Queued the routine test-strengthening correction [SEED-393#recovery-proof-covers-historical-case-paths](../seeds/SEED-393-test-quality-learning-from-effort-replays.md#recovery-proof-covers-historical-case-paths) (plan 677). It sits after the retrospective follow-up SEED-393#guidance-check-participants-run-owning-proof, with no priority exception.
